results.program_or_pathway: Taiwan Film and Audiovisual Institute (TFAI) Cash Rebate
results.starting_issue: Current enabling regulation/decision plus administering-agency guidelines, QPE schedule, forms and audit/final-claim manual.
results.authoritative_rule_set: TFAI rebate identity is wrong. Current TAICCA TICP 2.0 is co-investment up to 49% of total budget, generally uncapped (option 2 USD600k), requiring Taiwan elements, international co-finance/production and distribution; committee discretion/profit sharing apply.
results.optimizer_consequence: Retire rebate identity; later model selective/recoupable TAICCA investment.

results.starting_issue: Capture members, structures, contribution conditions, calls, caps, recoupment and interactions.
results.authoritative_rule_set: IBERMEDIA is a 21-state intergovernmental fund, not a treaty and grants no national treatment. Annual awards are separate from domestic co-production certification and incentives.
results.optimizer_consequence: Separate fund eligibility, official co-production status and domestic incentives.
results.instrument: IBERMEDIA intergovernmental programme and annual rules (not a treaty)
results.contribution_rules: Fund mainly from member contributions and loan repayments; selective awards; co-production request maximum USD150k fiction/USD100k documentary.
results.competent_authorities: Intergovernmental Council, Technical Unit and designated national cinematographic authorities.
results.domestic_incentive_interaction: Separate domestic certification and incentive rules always apply.
